Review complete. The clone remained read-only throughout (porcelain clean, HEAD unchanged, zero writes inside the clone); VERDICT.md and all scratch harnesses live outside the clone in the review root.

## Summary — R26 verdict: **approve** (exact-SHA; grants no merge)

**Target:** issue 463, r25/gen6 @ `e3b997b6`, tree `1a6b352c` — verified, working tree clean.

**Executor evidence — all independently reproduced:**
| claim | result |
|---|---|
| registry 684/684 | `PHẢN CHỨNG: 684/684 đỏ đúng`, `TỔNG: ĐẠT` ✓ |
| revert mutant killed by exact fixture | revert `<<-` change → 684→**683**; witness flips RAISE→NO-RAISE; killer = `heredoc-dash-tab-continuation-substitution` ✓ |
| actionlint pass | actionlint 1.7.7 on ci.yml → rc=0 ✓ |
| Ruff pass | ruff 0.15.15: 93 hits, all **style** (E701/E702), **0 F-codes**; no repo config; CI only probes `ruff --version` ✓ (substantively) |
| A8 967/1000, two paths | numstat 841+126=**967**, exactly the 2 write-set files ✓ |

**The `<<-` change verified correct:** leading tabs are stripped *before* the logical-continuation scan, so a tab-indented `$`+`(` split correctly rejects; the space-indented counterpart (`$ (`) correctly accepts. I also confirmed the second r25 path (PowerShell `.split("\n")` vs `.splitlines()`) is load-bearing — reverting it flips 6 CR/VT-separator fixtures (684→678).

**Hunt: 8 directions (≥2/class), zero product defects.** Unknown installers (pipx/poetry/conda/npm/`-r`) correctly stay `KHONG_PHAN_TICH_DUOC` not `KHONG`; multi-line carry chaining, backslash parity, and arithmetic all match bash/fail-close; consumer reads all jobs (A7), treats `if:`-gated installs as out-of-domain, and rejects alternate line-separators.

**One non-blocking finding — F-R26-A8 [P3, traceability]** (something prior reviews missed): the in-repo spec at this SHA **and on origin/master** is **revision 12, A8 ≤ 300** (`49844d77`), but the packet runs at 967 under an owner-authorized **≤1000** exception that lives **only out-of-tree** (SPEC-r24.md rev24 `79ba77c3` + lease pin + issue comments) — that revision was **never committed to the repo**. The packet cannot fix this (A8 forbids touching the spec as a 3rd path); it's the owner/land step's job. **Caveat recorded:** this stays P3 only because the ≤1000 authorization is corroborated by two independent artifacts; if that authorization were invalid it escalates to **P1**, so the land-approver must readback the authorization before landing.

All three classes (installer/domain, lexer/structure, consumer/workflow) approve on both spec and standards axes → header **approve**.

One environment note worth surfacing: `SPEC-r25.md` named in the prompt was **not present** in the review root (only `SPEC-r24.md`); I used the lease-pinned rev24 as the governing spec and documented the substitution in the verdict.
